_comment: Route 2b ε-identical replay demonstration. Pairs the Paper 3 cael-trace-fold determinism falsification with a SAXPY kernel whose output is f32 and is operationally deterministic at the workgroup level. tolerance_epsilon=1e-6 means two f32 outputs differing by <1e-6 per element are treated as the same replay.
section: replay-determinism (Route 2b ε-identical) — verify that the f32 SAXPY output collapses to a single SHA-256 after ε-quantization across N replications on the same adapter, recovering an ε-identical replay claim where the bit-identical cael-trace-fold-v1 claim was falsified
